استغشين (form X)
# اِسْتَغْشَيْنَ (istaḡšayna) /is.taɣ.ʃaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغْشَى (istaḡšā)
# اُسْتُغْشِينَ (ustuḡšīna) /us.tuɣ.ʃiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْشَى (istaḡšā)
# اِسْتَغْشِينَ (istaḡšīna) /is.taɣ.ʃiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْشَى (istaḡšā)
